narrative: The step-1 login form submit correlates to the persona's own current-step click, per F179 — a same-origin POST initiated synchronously within that click's event-handler continuation — so it correctly executes under the precondition_step exemption (F127). A concurrent, uncorrelated analytics-beacon POST fires during the same step window, initiated from a background timer, not from the login click; it does NOT satisfy F179's correlation rule, so it is independently dry-run-blocked (F40's default), not silently exempted just because it happened during a precondition_step's window, and its abort is never misreported as the step's own login submission failing (F180, CR5-B2, negative control).
